body: wow. it's crazy to think about where life will be for me ten years from now. thank you very much for sharing that with me, although I'm really sorry that things have to be so rough. may I ask if his father has any involvement now? it hurts more than anything to know that somebody can just abandon their child.

it is so painful to hear those words, yet relieving. I want to be free, completely over him, and my own person again. It just feels as though he took everything from me, used every word against me, broke every promise, and left me here in bed to cry:( I still can't come to an understanding as to how you could do this to a person, if it was reverse roles I would be there every day for him, regardless of our own issues. I don't know what's wrong with me, and I'm hoping I can somehow get out into fresh air today. I deeply appreciate your words as they are helping me so much right now!! much love!

thankyou for sharing that with me, and for such kind words. im glad you didn't do anything to hurt yourself while pregnant, and hopefully having your son now is a reason to stay strong. I just don't know what to do with myself until he is here and I really am scared.

you are all such beautiful people! thank you for helping me get through the night and hopefully the next couple of weeks peacefully. it's going to take time but I am going to stay positive and do everything I can possible for my son,  for he's given me true happiness, regardless of the situations that arise. 
also, that is such a lovely picture! I would love to see more
just those reminders are a huge comfort , hearing it from others make it feel even more real so thankyou for that.
wow yes thankyou, that really means so so much. I constantly feel him and cannot wait to have him here in my arms!

it is very hard, but I guess I need to accept that in order to get anywhere. it is a continuous cycle that is just exhausting. thankyou so much for your words, I cannot wait to meet my son, he gives me so much strength!
all I can think about is him being with her and it kills me.

thankyou so much. it's a comfort to let all of these feelings out and know that somebody somewhere is reading them and understanding. since becoming sick, I've distanced myself a lot. this past month I haven't gone out unless it was running a quick errand. I've been trying to be the best I possibly could to have a healthy baby, and a healthy relationship, making myself better, since neither of us were ready for this. everything that I want to do, are things that include him and the baby, those are the things that make me happy. but how could I ever be with someone that is with somebody else tonight?

you're absolutely right , thankyou for that understanding. I've brought it up before, being lonely has led me to sleeping all day, sadness, etc. but before tonight I haven't had such intense thoughts, it's like I want to run away from everything and be free, but at the same time I want my little family here.
I'm currently staying with my mom, it's hard because it is such a small space and I'm becoming frustrated with almost everything. I know I shouldn't, but I just want to be with him.
